chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ja'far ibn al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid al-Khazzaz, from al-Walid ibn Aqaba, from al-Harith ibn Ziyad, from Shu'ayb, from Abu Hamza, who said: I entered upon Abu Abdillah

and said to him: Are you the master of this matter? He said: No. I said: Is it your son? He said: No. I said: Is it your grandson? He said: No. I said: Is it your grandson's son? He said: No. I said: Then who is he? He said: He is the one who will fill it with justice, as it was filled with oppression and tyranny. He will come after a cessation of the Imams, just as the Prophet was sent after a cessation of the Messengers.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: The Master of the Matter (referring to the Imam/Mahdi)
key_terms.فَتْرَة: Cessation or intermission (period of occultation or gap between prophets/imams)

ai.seo_question: Who is the Mahdi according to Imam al-Sadiq and when will he appear?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the doctrine of the Major Occultation by distinguishing the Mahdi from the immediate line of Imams, identifying him as the one who will fill the earth with justice after a period of 'fatrah' (cessation). The reference to 'fatrah' draws a parallel between the Imam's reappearance and the prophetic mission of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), emphasizing his role in restoring divine equity after an era of tyranny. This hadith is foundational in Shia scholarship for understanding the transition from the visible Imamate to the hidden Imam.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (38) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob al-Kulayni narrated from Muhammad bin Yahya from Ahmad bin Idreess from Muhammad bin Ahmad from Ja’far bin al-Qassim from Muhammad bin al-Waleed al-Khazzaz from al-Waleed bin Aqaba from al-Harith bin Ziyad that Shu’ayb bin Abu Hamza had said: “Once I came to Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) and said to him: Are you the man of this matter?”

He said: “No.” I said: “Is he your son?” He said: “No.” I said: “Is he your grandson?” He said: “No.” I said: “Is he your grandson’s son?” He said: “No.” I said: “Who is he then?” He said: “It is he, who will fill the world with justice after it has been filled with injustice and oppression. He will come after a cessation of imams as Prophet Muhammad (as) has been sent after a cessation of prophets.”
